description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Able to cast 1st level or higher spells of the elemental school or proficiency with held weapon

Benefit: Whenever an ally with this teamwork feat declares intent to attack a target with their weapon (before they roll for attack), you may channel the energies of a spell you know that belongs to the elemental school (thereby expending the requisite MP as if casting normally) to augment their next attack with additional elemental damage as an immediate action. The type of elemental damage depends on the elemental branch of the channeled spell, with the amount of extra damage being equal to 1d6 per spell level of the spell (ex: channeling the Flare spell would add 6d6 fire damage to an ally's attack). The caster must be able see and be within 30 feet of the attack being made. A weapon can only benefit from one Magicked Strike effect at a time, with the effect being expended if the attack misses.
